name: git-together
description: Git Together — Find your people. Build something great.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
